name: 48359 · Lake Orion, MI
findings: ZIP 48359 (Lake Orion) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (61%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48359 (Lake Orion) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
